text: dsh-workspace-mesh 是面向 DSH Web 的多主机工作区调度插件。它通过 assignment.yml 将工作区映射到节点，并注册模型工具，让 Lead 按工作区把目标发送到对应 DSH 会话、等待最终回复，同时查看节点、任务和本地运行状态。设置页可查看 mesh 快照并管理配置。适合在多台 DSH 主机间分配工作，而代码明确将 agent loop 留在工作区所在机器。需要配置 peer 地址与登录 token；共享密钥可选，用于握手中继。

dsh-workspace-mesh routes DSH tasks by workspace across paired hosts. Assignments map workspaces to nodes; tools dispatch objectives to remote sessions, return replies, and report node or task status. Configure peer addresses and login tokens; a shared secret is optional for relay.
想让一个 DSH 主机把任务发给另一台机器上的工作区。
我有多台 DSH，怎么按工作区归属自动投递工作？
能否查看 mesh 里有哪些节点和它们承载的工作区？
希望远程会话处理目标后，把最终回复带回当前会话。
I want one DSH instance to dispatch work to the host that owns a workspace.
How can I inspect peer nodes and check the status of a distributed DSH task?
dsh-workspace-mesh 的功能「工作区定向派发」：调用 mesh_dispatch 提供 workspaceId 与目标，插件按 assignment 路由到 peer 会话，并返回最终回复或超时状态。
dsh-workspace-mesh 的功能「节点与工作区清单」：调用 mesh_list_nodes 可按 nodeId 或 workspaceId 过滤节点，结果合并 assignment 与传输回执，并列出节点承载的工作区。
dsh-workspace-mesh 的功能「任务和运行状态查看」：mesh_task_status 按 taskId 查询内存任务板记录；mesh_status 提供本机传输、分配表和任务计数概览。
dsh-workspace-mesh 会把派发目标及会话交互发送到配置的 DSH peer；连接使用 peer 登录 token，也可配置共享密钥启用 relay。具体接收主机由 peers 配置决定。
dsh-workspace-mesh 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 9 天；提交数 53；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

**English** · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Workspace **mesh** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — a grid of
*workspaces*, not of agents.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · dsh-workspace-mesh：> **Not resource remote-access.** The agent loop never leaves the machine that owns the workspace.
> Peers exchange messages only: no remote shell, no remote file API — by design
> ([SPEC.md](./SPEC.md) §8, §16.6).

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Why：You run more than one DSH instance: a laptop, a staging box, a cloud host. Work does not spread
evenly over them — a workspace *belongs* to one machine, and the repository, the credentials and the
long-running sessions live there.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Why：Proxying a conversation to that machine already works, and it has the right shape: the agent loop
stays where the files are. What is missing is the other direction — **one Lead that dispatches work
by workspace, to the machine that owns it, and reads the result back**, without knowing which box
is which.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Why：```text
  caller node                                  owning node
  ┌──────────────────────────┐                 ┌──────────────────────────┐
  │ Lead agent               │  mesh_dispatch  │ session in ws-blog       │
  │ mesh_dispatch(ws-blog) ──┼─── messages ───▶│ agent loop runs HERE     │

dsh-workspace-mesh README · What it does：| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Declares placement** | `assignment.yml` maps `workspaceId → nodeId`, plus the remote `cwd` a new session owns. Static by design — no discovery, no hub process. |
| **Dispatches by workspace** | `mesh_dispatch` creates a session on the owning machine, sends the objective, and blocks until the final reply (or `dispatchTimeoutMs`). |
| **Reports, never guesses** | `mesh_list_nodes` merges the assignment table with transport receipts. A peer without a receipt is `unknown` — never `online`. |
| **Stays out of execution** | Across the machine boundary only `session/*` and `workspace/*` calls travel. |
| **Degrades, does not crash** | No peers? The plugin still loads; `mesh_dispatch` reports `unavailable` and the other three tools keep working. |
| **Zero runtime dependencies** | Plain JSON Schema tool definitions; cordis services are probed at runtime instead of imported from the host (SPEC §9.4). |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Requirements：| | |
| --- | --- |
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2` — declared in `dsh.engines`, checked when the bundle loads |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| Runtime dependencies | none |
| Peers | a DSH instance serving its web UI (the transport calls `/connect` and `/api/...` there) |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workspace-mesh
```

Or mount it from an overlay patch (`--patch`) without installing — `name` is a module specifier:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mesh
      name: dsh-workspace-mesh
```

The bundled [cordis.patch.yml](./cordis.patch.yml) ships empty on purpose: the entry belongs to the
deployer's profile patch, which keeps it uniquely addressed.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 1. Install on every node you want to address：The caller needs the plugin for the tools and the transport. A peer needs it to publish its native
workspaces (`GET /api/mesh/workspaces`) and, in relay mode, to serve the handshake and relay routes.
A peer without it still works when every assignment carries a `cwd`: the transport then creates the
session in that directory.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Credentials：| Mode | Configure | After the peer restarts | Authority on the peer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| login token (default) | `peers[].token` | the token rotates; update it by hand | the owner's full access |
| relay | `peers[].token` + the same `meshSecret` on both nodes | automatic re-handshake, nothing to update | a 10-minute mesh token, five session operations |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Credentials：In relay mode the caller signs `mesh-handshake:<nodeId>:<ts>:<nonce>` with the shared secret and
trades it for a short-lived token, so nothing depends on the rotating login token. The handshake and
relay routes sit below the browser fence — the caller has no cookie yet — and verify that token
themselves.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Credentials：Peers back off after two consecutive failures (60 s, doubling, capped at 16×) instead of hammering a
stale credential: a steady stream of 401s is exactly what a host intrusion filter bans this machine
for.

> **Keep the mesh on a trusted network.** The login token *is* the peer's owner session. Relay mode
> narrows that to five session operations, but neither mode replaces the credential layer in SPEC
> §17, which does not exist yet ([decisions.md](./docs/explanation/decisions.md) D13).

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Model tools：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `mesh_list_nodes` | Roster: the assignment table merged with transport receipts, filterable by `nodeId` / `workspaceId`. |
| `mesh_status` | Local snapshot — transport, assignment table, task board counts, lifecycle. Never calls the network. |
| `mesh_dispatch` | Dispatch a task and block for the reply. Returns `taskId`, `target`, `state`, `result` or an `error` code. |
| `mesh_task_status` | Read one task off the in-memory board (cleared when the process exits). |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Model tools：Error codes: `unavailable`, `unknown-node`, `invalid-target`, `denied`, `node-offline`, `timeout`,
`remote-failure`. Parameters, output shapes and the `replyMode` caveat:
[docs/reference/tools.md](./docs/reference/tools.md).

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Settings page：The browser half registers four surfaces: a **Workspace mesh** section in Settings, a live
configuration card on the plugin's own page, a left-rail entry, and the workspace page that entry
opens — every reachable workspace, which machine owns it, whether that machine is online, a message
box for it, and a read-only view of a remote session's tail. Remote workspaces are virtual there:
nothing is copied, the loop still runs on the owning machine.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Settings page：```text
browser routes   behind the host's signed-cookie fence
  GET  /api/mesh/state        read-only snapshot the page renders
  POST /api/mesh/config       validate + persist a config patch, apply the hot fields
  GET  /api/mesh/workspaces   this node's native workspaces, published to peers

Payloads, status codes and the hot/restart split:
[docs/reference/http-api.md](./docs/reference/http-api.md).

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Configuration：The entry config (`config:` in the profile patch) is layered under
`$DSH_HOME/mesh-config.json`, the file the settings page writes:

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Applies |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transport` | `auto` | `auto` | restart |
| `peers` | `{ nodeId, baseUrl, token }[]` | `[]` | restart |
| `meshSecret` | string | `''` | restart |
| `assignmentFile` | string | `''` (not loaded) | immediately |
| `leaseMs` | integer, ms | `900000` | immediately |
| `dispatchTimeoutMs` | integer, ms | `120000` | immediately |
| `leaseOwner` | string | `mesh-lead` | immediately |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Configuration：`leaseMs` must stay greater than `dispatchTimeoutMs`, otherwise dispatch refuses with `denied` — a
slow task must not be fenced by its own expired lease. Field semantics and the other invariants:
[docs/reference/config.md](./docs/reference/config.md).

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Status：Working, with tests: tool registration and argument validation, the in-memory board with
lease/fencing, roster derivation, `assignment.yml` parsing (errors carry file and line), config
layering and hot reload, the settings routes, the browser dispatch path, the Typert transport in both
credential modes (backoff on a failing peer, one replay for read-only calls), remote workspace and
session listing, and remote session history. The self-restart controller and the identity primitives
exist but are not wired to a request path.

dsh-workspace-mesh README · Status：| | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `mesh_task_wait` / `mesh_cancel` | They need a persistent task board and a cancel channel; the board is in memory. |
| A `replyMode: "stream"` that advances on its own | Same reason: no background collector, so a stream dispatch returns `running` + `pending: true` and stays there. |
| `mesh_lifecycle`, `mesh_plugin_*`, grants (T1–T3) | They need the cross-machine planes in SPEC §14–§16 first. |
| A hub or broadcast registry | Placement is the static `assignment.yml` ([decisions.md](./docs/explanation/decisions.md) D3). |
| Remote shell or file access | Not implemented, and not planned (SPEC §16.6). |

[English](./README.md) · **中文**

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的工作区**网格**（mesh）：网格里排的是
*工作区*，不是 agent。

> **不是资源远程访问。** agent loop 永远不离开工作区所在的机器，跨机只传消息：没有远程 shell，也没有远程
> 文件接口，这是设计约束（[SPEC.md](./SPEC.md) §8、§16.6）。

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 为什么：你手上有不止一台 DSH：笔记本、测试机、云主机。工作不是均匀分布的——一个工作区只属于一台机器，仓库、凭据、
长跑会话都在那台机器上。

把对话代理到那台机器已经能用，方向也对：agent loop 留在文件所在的地方。缺的是反方向——**让一个 Lead 按工作区
把任务投递到归属它的机器，并拿回结果**，而不用先搞清楚哪台是哪台。

```text
  调用方节点                                    归属节点
  ┌──────────────────────────┐                 ┌──────────────────────────┐
  │ Lead agent               │  mesh_dispatch  │ ws-blog 里的会话         │
  │ mesh_dispatch(ws-blog) ──┼─── 只传消息 ───▶│ agent loop 在这里跑      │

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 它做什么：| | |
| --- | --- |
| **声明归属** | `assignment.yml` 把 `workspaceId → nodeId` 写死，附带远端会话要占用的 `cwd`。静态分配是刻意的——没有自动发现，也没有 hub 进程。 |
| **按工作区投递** | `mesh_dispatch` 在归属机上建会话、发目标，然后阻塞到最终回复（或 `dispatchTimeoutMs` 超时）。 |
| **只报告，不猜** | `mesh_list_nodes` 把 assignment 声明与传输回执合并；没有回执的节点是 `unknown`，**绝不伪造** `online`。 |
| **不越界执行** | 跨过机器边界只有 `session/*` 与 `workspace/*` 两类调用。 |
| **降级不崩溃** | 没配 `peers` 时插件照常加载：`mesh_dispatch` 报 `unavailable`，其余三个工具照常可用。 |
| **零运行时依赖** | 工具定义是裸 JSON Schema；cordis 服务在运行期探测，而不是 import 宿主里的包（SPEC §9.4）。 |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 环境要求：| | |
| --- | --- |
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2`——写在 `dsh.engines` 里，bundle 加载时校验 |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| 运行时依赖 | 无 |
| 对端 | 一台对外提供 web UI 的 DSH 实例（传输调它的 `/connect` 与 `/api/...`） |

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 凭证：| 模式 | 配什么 | 对端重启后 | 在对端的权限 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 登录 token（默认） | `peers[].token` | token 轮换，必须手工更新 | 对端 owner 的全权 |
| relay | `peers[].token` + 两端相同的 `meshSecret` | 自动重新握手，什么都不用改 | 10 分钟有效的 mesh token，只放行五个会话操作 |

relay 模式下，调用方用共享密钥签 `mesh-handshake:<nodeId>:<ts>:<nonce>`，换一个短期 token，所以整条链路
不再依赖会轮换的登录 token。握手与中继路由挂在浏览器鉴权栅栏**之下**——调用方手里还没有 cookie——由它们自己
验 mesh token。

同一个 peer 连续失败两次后进入冷却（60 秒起，逐次翻倍，上限 16 倍），而不是拿着过期凭证硬打。这不是性能优化：
没有退避时，一个过期 token 会变成持续的 401 流，而对端的入侵过滤正是按这个特征把本机 IP 封掉的。

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 凭证：> **只把 mesh 放在可信网络上。** 登录 token 就是对端的 owner 会话。relay 模式把它收窄成五个会话操作，但两种
> 模式都替代不了 SPEC §17 描述、目前还不存在的凭据层（[decisions.md](./docs/explanation/decisions.md) D13）。

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 模型工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `mesh_list_nodes` | roster：assignment 声明 + 传输回执合并，可按 `nodeId` / `workspaceId` 过滤。 |
| `mesh_status` | 本地快照：传输、assignment、任务板计数、生命周期。不发任何网络请求。 |
| `mesh_dispatch` | 投递任务并阻塞到回复。返回 `taskId`、`target`、`state`、`result` 或 `error` 码。 |
| `mesh_task_status` | 从内存任务板读一条任务（进程退出即清空）。 |

错误码：`unavailable`、`unknown-node`、`invalid-target`、`denied`、`node-offline`、`timeout`、
`remote-failure`。参数、返回形状与 `replyMode` 的注意事项见
[docs/reference/tools.md](./docs/reference/tools.md)。

dsh-workspace-mesh README · 设置页：浏览器半区注册了四块界面：设置里的「工作区网格」一节、插件详情页上的实时配置卡、左栏的「工作区网格」入口，
以及这个入口打开的整页——列出这台实例能触达的每个工作区、它归哪台机器、那台机器在不在线，能给它发一条消息，也
能只读地看远端会话的尾部。远端工作区在那里是虚拟的：什么都不复制，loop 仍然跑在归属机上。

```text
浏览器路由    在宿主的签名 cookie 栅栏内
  GET  /api/mesh/state       设置页渲染的只读快照
  POST /api/mesh/config      校验并落盘配置补丁，应用热字段
  GET  /api/mesh/workspaces  本机的原生工作区，供对端读取

请求体、状态码与热/重启边界：[docs/reference/http-api.md](./docs/reference/http-api.md)。

| --- | --- |
| `mesh_task_wait` / `mesh_cancel` | 需要持久化任务板和取消通道；任务板现在在内存里。 |
| 会自己推进的 `replyMode: "stream"` | 同一个原因：没有后台收集器，stream 投递返回 `running` + `pending: true` 之后就不会再动。 |
| `mesh_lifecycle`、`mesh_plugin_*`、授权矩阵（T1–T3） | 依赖 SPEC §14–§16 的跨机面先成立。 |
| hub / 广播注册表 | 归属只来自静态的 `assignment.yml`（[decisions.md](./docs/explanation/decisions.md) D3）。 |
| 远程 shell 与远程文件访问 | 没做，也不打算做（SPEC §16.6）。 |
